label: Indigenous societies
description: Many distinct peoples and polities, never a single Caribbean empire.

label: Shared / unsettled
description: Concurrent administrations, disputed rule, or an interval without established colonial government. Read each island’s notes.

label: Spain
description: Spanish monarchy and its colonial administrations.

label: Netherlands
description: Dutch Republic, colonial companies, and the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

label: England / Britain
description: England before 1707; Great Britain and then the United Kingdom.

label: France
description: French colonial companies, monarchy, republics and empires.

label: United States
description: Military occupations are distinct from sovereignty. Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands are U.S. territories.

label: Denmark
description: Danish colonial company and crown; Denmark–Norway before 1814.

label: Sweden
description: Swedish crown and colonial company; Guadeloupe was a title without Swedish administration.

label: Courland
description: The Duchy of Courland and Semigallia, in present-day Latvia.

label: Knights of Malta
description: Proprietary administration by the Order of Saint John under French sovereignty.

label: Gran Colombia
description: The Republic of Colombia established in 1819, conventionally called Gran Colombia.

label: Venezuela
description: Venezuelan republican government; Margarita is part of today’s Nueva Esparta state.

label: Independent
description: Sovereign island states. Commonwealth membership or a shared monarch does not imply British ownership.
